podcastPage._note: Package names, prices and inclusions must come from the matching SimplyBook service. A tier with active=false is not published. An inclusion line is a promise — only list what that exact SimplyBook package includes. Guidance and add-on items only appear when offered=true.

headline: Record Your Podcast
Your Way
levels.body: From the room on its own to a finished episode with clips. Pick the level of help you want and book it.
levels.note: Live prices, availability and add-ons are confirmed at checkout.

items.name: Self-Service
items.positioning: For experienced creators who want the room and equipment.
includes: The room for your booked time
Cameras, audio and lighting configured before you arrive
Teleprompter where the service includes it
Your raw files delivered after the session

items.name: With Technician
items.positioning: For clients who want someone operating the session.
includes: A KLIP technician running the session
Camera switching and audio monitored live

items.name: Full-Service Podcast
items.positioning: For clients who want to record and receive a finished episode.
includes: Branding elements where the package includes them

items.name: Premium Content Package
items.positioning: For clients who want the episode plus social assets.
includes: Short clips, captions and thumbnails where the package includes them

headline: What We Can
Handle For You
handle.body: Everything below is available through KLIP. What lands in your booking depends on the package you choose.

headline: Need Help
With The Show?
guidance.body: First episode or hundredth, the parts around the recording are usually what decide whether a show keeps going.

hostSupport.title: Host Or Co-Host Support
hostSupport.text: A KLIP host or co-host can run the conversation with you. Available as an add-on.
